basic_details.job_title: NAM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Accounting Clerk, Optometrist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Three contract posts are open at the Alappuzha District Programme Management and Support Unit of the National AYUSH Mission: Accounting Clerk, Optometrist and Physiotherapist, one vacancy each. The monthly remuneration is Rs. 17,000 for Accounting Clerk, Rs. 17,850 for Optometrist and Rs. 21,000 for Physiotherapist. The age limit for all three posts is 40 years as on the last date. Applications must be submitted online on the NAM careers portal (careers.nam.kerala.gov.in) by 15 November 2026.

age_limit.details: For each of the three posts, the age must not exceed 40 years as on the last date (15/11/2026). The notice does not mention any minimum age or age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: The notice asks for online applications only. The steps it gives are:
Check that you meet the eligibility criteria for the post.
Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in/index.php.
Clearly mention all the details while filling the application, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Complete the online submission by 15/11/2026, the last date for online applications.
The particulars given in the online form must match the original documents, which candidates produce at the time of interview.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About NAM Alappuzha
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the District Programme Management & Supporting Unit of the National AYUSH Mission in Alappuzha, which works from the District Homoeo Hospital Building, Bazar P.O, Alappuzha 688012. The notice carries the seal of the District AYUSH Health Society, Alappuzha, and is signed by the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Alappuzha. The office can be reached on phone 0477-2991481 and email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 3 vacancies in total, one for each post. All three posts are on contract basis. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Accounting Clerk must hold all three essential qualifications: a B.Com degree from a recognised university, a Recognised Diploma in Computer Application and a Certificate in Tally. The notice lists these desirable qualifications for this post: Typewriting in English and Malayalam Working experience in AYUSH & Health sector Exposure in Social sector schemes The Optometrist needs a BSc Optometry or a two years diploma in Optometry. The notice names no desirable qualification or experience for this post. The Physiotherapist needs a Graduation or Post Graduation in Physiotherapy approved by a recognized University. The notice names no desirable qualification or experience for this post. For each of the three posts, the age must not exceed 40 years as on the last date (15/11/2026). The notice does not mention any minimum age or age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

BSc Optometry/ two years diploma in Optometry

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts are filled on contract basis. The notice prints a fixed monthly remuneration for each post: Accounting Clerk 17,000/-, Optometrist 17,850/- and Physiotherapist 21,000/-. The notice does not mention any allowance or the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Alappuzha Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks for online applications only. The steps it gives are: Check that you meet the eligibility criteria for the post. Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in/index.php . Clearly mention all the details while filling the application, because incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Complete the online submission by 15/11/2026, the last date for online applications. The particulars given in the online form must match the original documents, which candidates produce at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the selection procedure includes a Skill Test/Written Test and an Interview, as the case may be. The notice does not give dates, venue or the pattern of the test or interview. At the interview, candidates produce their original documents; if the particulars in the application form do not tally with them, the candidature will be rejected.
